# VirtualContainerOpenError Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

## Extends
- *Error*

Error thrown when a virtual container cannot be shown to a player. Contains a reason code indicating why the screen request was not sent.

## Properties

### **reason**
`read-only reason: VirtualContainerOpenErrorReason;`

The [*@minecraft/server.VirtualContainerOpenErrorReason*](../../../scriptapi/minecraft/server/VirtualContainerOpenErrorReason.md) code that indicates why the screen request was not sent.

Type: [*VirtualContainerOpenErrorReason*](VirtualContainerOpenErrorReason.md)

Notes:
  - This property can be read in early-execution mode.
